title: AI and Python Django Intern
description:
**About**   
Vynzora Private Limited is a technology\-driven digital solutions company based in Kochi, specializing in advertising, branding, web development, and IT services. We help businesses navigate their digital transformation journey — from strategy and implementation to optimization and continuous innovation.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a proactive AI \& Python Django Intern to join our development team at Vynzora Pvt. Ltd. This internship is ideal for candidates who have a foundation in both Python web development and Data Science/Artificial Intelligence. You will work on backend development using Django and Django REST Framework, integrate APIs with React, contribute to AI and machine learning projects, analyze datasets, and gain hands\-on experience with cloud deployment and real\-world applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Develop and maintain backend applications using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework (DRF).

· Build and integrate RESTful APIs with React.js front\-end applications.

· Assist in developing AI and Machine Learning models for real\-world business applications.

· Work on data preprocessing, analysis, visualization, and model evaluation.

· Support projects involving Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Large Language Models (LLMs).

· Create dashboards and reports using Power BI and Tableau.

· Analyze datasets using Python, SQL, and Microsoft Excel.

· Assist in deploying and managing applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, DigitalOcean, Azure, or Google Cloud.

· Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.

· Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and maintain proper technical documentation.

**Requirements:**

**Python \& Web Development**

* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python.
* Familiarity with Django and Django REST Framework (DRF).
* Understanding of React.js and API integration.
* Knowledge of RESTful API development.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
* Familiarity with PostgreSQL or MySQL databases.
* Basic understanding of Git/GitHub.

**AI, Machine Learning \& Data Science**

* Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts and algorithms.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning fundamentals.
* Basic knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Exposure to Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI concepts.
* Experience using Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of data visualization and dashboarding using Power BI and Tableau.
* Good understanding of Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.

**Cloud \& Deployment**

* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, DigitalOcean, Azure, Google Cloud, or Heroku.
* Basic understanding of deployment workflows and application hosting.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Eagerness to learn new technologies.
* Good communication and teamwork.
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently.

**Perks**

* Hands\-on experience in Python, Django, AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science.
* Exposure to Deep Learning, NLP, LLM\-based applications, and cloud deployment.
* Opportunity to work on live client and internal AI projects.
* Mentorship from experienced developers.
* Certificate of Completion and Internship Letter.
* Potential full\-time opportunity based on performance.

**How To Apply**

Apply directly through Indeed or send your resume to hrvynzora@gmail.com with the subject line "Application for AI \& Python Django Intern".

Pay: ₹4,000\.00 \- ₹9,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
